rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a material template for presenting an outside advisory body's report to Congress. Both letters praise a distinguished, nonpartisan committee's findings; connect military and economic assistance to the strength and security of the free world; explain how the report bears on forthcoming foreign-aid recommendations; and transmit the report for congressional consideration. C20 is directly connected to the child because it created the committee and requested preliminary conclusions for the next Mutual Security Program, but it is principally the initiating assignment rather than the closest drafting model for the later report-transmittal letter. C02 has a similar commission-report and future-legislation structure, but concerns a different policy field and shares less distinctive substantive language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee, composed of eminent Americans, has made an excellent study ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is a great satisfaction to me that a nonpartisan group, such as your Board, representing labor, education, business, agriculture and other aspects of our national life, should reach unanimous agreement ...
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize a broadly representative citizen advisory body as authoritative and use its report to support presidential policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee has highlighted the necessity for a truly mutual effort ... assistance which strengthens us as it strengthens our allies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The task, as you have pointed out, is one that the United States cannot undertake alone. We depend, in many respects, on the other free nations, and they on us. International partnership is necessary ...
shared_material.explanation: The letters use closely parallel mutual-effort reasoning to connect assistance abroad with United States and free-world strength.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The unanimous findings of the Committee in its interim report confirm the imperative need for Congress to authorize and appropriate the full amount requested for both economic and military assistance ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In the near future, I shall send recommendations to the Congress concerning the legislation required for foreign defense and economic assistance for 1952. I know that your report will be of great help ...
shared_material.explanation: Each makes the advisory report materially relevant to congressional action on combined military and economic foreign assistance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I enclose the Committee's Interim Report for the earnest consideration of the Congress.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The International Development Advisory Board has now completed that task and has submitted a report to me, a copy of which I am enclosing herewith ... I am sure that you and the members of your Committee will find it valuable ...
shared_material.explanation: Both culminate in transmitting the advisory report for congressional consideration, completing the same functional letter structure.
